source.publication: 2025 IT-140 Personal Income Tax Forms and Instructions (West Virginia Tax Division), with Schedule M bound in
source.section: Schedule M line 33(a)-(b) Other Retirement Modification, 'Combined amounts of 33a and 33b must not exceed $2,000' (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.22); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Single, age 55, a West Virginia PERS pension of 1,500, under the 2,000 cap, and wages. filer born 1970-02-14, age 55 at December 31, 2025. Federal AGI (given) = wages 40,000.00 + West Virginia PERS/Teachers' pension 1,500.00 = 41,500.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 41,500.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 25,750.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 41,500.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M Column A: line 33(a) WV Teachers'/PERS 1,500.00, line 33(b) federal retirement 0.00; line 33 = lesser of their sum 1,500.00 and 2,000.00 = 1,500.00; line 47: age 55, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 1,500.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 1,500.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 1,500.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 41,500.00 + 0.00 - 1,500.00 = 40,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 40,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 38,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 13,000.00 = 432.9; total 1098.9 = 1,098.90. The Tax Table row 37,960 to under 38,020 (PDF p.38 on) gives 1,099; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 1,098.90.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
